title: Cracking White-box DNN Watermarks via Invariant Neuron Transforms

problem.claim: Protecting the intellectual property of deep neural networks is a major concern for the AI industry.

gap.claim: Existing white-box model watermarking schemes are claimed to be secure against most known watermark removal attacks, motivating investigation of their robustness.

contributions.claim: The work concerns cracking white-box DNN watermarks through invariant neuron transforms.

author_reported_evidence.claim: White-box model watermarking is claimed to sacrifice less functionality, use more knowledge about the target model, and be accurate, credible, and secure against most known watermark removal attacks.

narrative_sequence.summary: Protecting DNN intellectual property is a major industry concern.
Watermarking strategies embed secret identity messages in model prediction behavior or internal model properties.
White-box watermarking uses more target-model knowledge and is claimed to provide stronger functionality and security properties.
